scenes.text: HIPAA — the regulations, and the fines.
Three rules: privacy, security, and breach notification.
Plans, providers, clearinghouses, and business associates all comply.
Penalties hit four tiers — from one-thirty-seven per violation, up to two million dollars a year.
Shieldra — the AI that shields your business.
